// scenario for strings_replace_neg_one_replaceall: `strings.Replace(..., -1)` instead of `strings.ReplaceAll(...)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario662Positive(s, old, new string) string {
	return strings.Replace(s, old, new, -1)
